model_definition.name: Mašín2005 AppendixC/source-plus conservative SPD interior — v0.3 rate candidate
model_definition.description: Original five-physical-parameter AppendixC base, zero spin, compression-positive full7rate research draft. Additive correction: pinned manuscript Eq38 has PLUS unloading bracket, consistent withEq40 and AppendixC; previous minus claim is historical extraction error. Same source rate algebra asv1. Separate normalized Cartesian/Mandel diagonal/minor64epsilon guards restrict numerical interior; not certifiedSPD theorem. RawLode margin and j2 floor unchanged; no clipping. No near-isotropic/near-singular rate accuracy, finite integration or admission claim. Explicit v0.3 strain-path contract; persistent effective Cauchy stress and scalar void ratio, infinitesimal fixed spatial zero-spin restriction. Accepted manuscript, not final-publisher equivalence. London-clay source calibration defaults are not universal clay parameters; illustrative stress/e is not a prepared specimen. No inferred initialization, finite-path verification or scientific admission.
